TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd brings directly relevant delivery experience across the two core pillars of CDA’s Safe-City scope: (i) resilient networks/data systems for a Command & Control Centre and (ii) on-ground civil/infrastructure execution on live roads. We are SECP incorporated and maintain ISO 27001 for information security management, aligning to the RFP’s requirement for secure command-and-control data systems [CO-PROFILE].

For network backbone and systems integration disciplines, we have delivered multiple network design deployments, including PKR 182M over 21 months (completed 2022) [CAP-009] and PKR 44M over 21 months (completed 2025) [CAP-021]. For cyber and platform security (critical to CCTV, storage, analytics and operator workflows), we executed a Provincial Government cybersecurity deployment valued at PKR 178M over 23 months (completed 2021) [CAP-049], and an international cybersecurity engagement delivered under ISO 27001 practices (PKR 15M over 34 months, completed 2023) [CAP-001]. We have also delivered government-grade infrastructure platforms via a Provincial Government cloud infrastructure project (PKR 158M over 22 months, completed 2020) [CAP-024].

For civil works competencies needed for poles, foundations, trenching/ducting corridors, and restoration, our past performance includes Federal Government road construction (PKR 177M over 32 months, completed 2020) [CAP-003], Provincial Government road construction (PKR 199M over 7 months, completed 2022) [CAP-015], and bridge engineering works (PKR 200M over 23 months, completed 2023) [CAP-028].

Mandatory eligibility note: our library does not yet evidence a PKR 1,500M+ safe-city/surveillance project as prime contractor, PEC registration in category C-B or higher, or ISO 14001 certification; our audited average annual turnover is PKR 900M [CO-PROFILE]. We will address these requirements through compliant joint-venture/consortium structuring with suitably registered/certified construction partners and by presenting assured access arrangements for specialized trenching/boring and pole-installation plant near Islamabad (to be evidenced at bid stage).
